text_block_list.text:
One day, with the spring Tenno Sho
drawing
close, Бива Хаяхидэ shows up
looking especially
exhausted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан, her sister, has recently won
the
Satsuki Sho and set a new track
record.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And the remarkable feat has dealt a
spectacular
blow to Бива Хаяхидэ,
casting a shadow of
doubt over her
mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин confesses to Biwa
Hayahide that
she's always thought of
her as a "real pain in the
butt."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Though her attempt to bring comfort is
awkward
at best, it's Нарита Таисин's
best effort to
encourage her friend and
rival.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
